kernel_migration.equivalence_check: 3,741 sealed holdout rows recomputed; zero per-field difference

scorer.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

results.sample_scope: unweighted selected cohorts, month x repeat cells equally weighted; not a nationally representative headline
results.quantiles: left-inverse empirical CDF for Q9 and Q8; interpolated IQR auxiliary only; old published Q8 interpolation remains historical, not overwritten
results.information_fairness: Baselines use own past only; LLMs also use public E. Same cohort/scorer eliminates evaluation mismatch, not information-set mismatch. Oracle C1 and nationwide errors not ranked here.
results.history_baseline_note: fixed candidate borrowed from Kimi C1 training result; Kimi trained on official means with a current-truth common shift. This past-only, frozen-score variant is not the identical C1 estimator and is not fitted on this cohort.

paired_intervals.scope: conditional on these four selected months, fixed histories and saved responses; not a national or future-month confidence interval
conditional on these four selected months, fixed histories and saved responses; not a national or future-month confidence interval

limitations: Four disconnected months, small selected cohorts and repeat generations do not identify national performance or a continuous trajectory.
Q9 headline-style sample center is median of individual approximate density MEANS, not median of Q8 or individual density medians.
Individual level MAE and individual update MAE share the same errors when using the same previous value; they are not independent evidence.
Intervals resample persons conditional on fixed months, not future environments; no multiple-comparison correction or causal identification.
Anchor-only baseline predicts a center, not a full ten-bin probability density; no fabricated probability shape.
